# Third-party data

`who_aware_2023.csv` is a tabular extraction of the "AWaRe classification 2023" worksheet from the
WHO AWaRe classification of antibiotics for evaluation and monitoring of use, 2023
(WHO/MHP/HPS/EML/2023.04). Columns: antibiotic, class, ATC code, AWaRe category.

It is © World Health Organization and is NOT covered by the MARS licences (CC-BY 4.0 / Apache 2.0).
Use is subject to WHO's terms for that publication. Refer to the original at
https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-MHP-HPS-EML-2023.04 for the authoritative list.
